Wonder Reader 0.1.8 (67) - 新增可选 PaddleOCR 本地文档识别，支持中英日及拉丁字母语言，并保留图片、表格行列和合并单元格。设置中一键下载约1GB模型；软件自带运行组件，无需安装Python。首次安装或升级需准备引擎，可查询阶段。 Added optional local PaddleOCR for Chinese, English, Japanese and Latin-script languages, with images and accessible table cells. Download approximately 1 GB of models in Settings; no separate Python installation is needed. Initial setup or upgrades prepare the engine and report that stage. - 修复PDF分页、图片附近向上逐行阅读时位置被回写的问题，保留系统原生文字导航，不更改旁白设置。 Fixed reading positions being moved forward again near PDF page and image boundaries, retaining native text navigation without changing VoiceOver settings. - 翻译不再先等待模型生成整本书术语表；改用书籍内已有译文和术语记忆，严格区分书籍、来源版本和目标语言。优化等价日期检查与受损扫描字符处理。 Translation no longer waits for a separate glossary-generation request. Book-specific translation and terminology memory is isolated by source version and target language, with improved equivalent-date validation and handling of damaged scan characters. - 翻译、OCR和总结使用各自流程。在线短文总结减少分段请求；只有当前任务成功完成才保存结果，明确选择的OCR引擎失败时不再用另一引擎冒充成功。Codex登录和模型选择保留。 Translation, OCR and summaries use separate workflows. Short online summaries need fewer requests, and results require successful completion of the current task. Explicit OCR choices no longer silently fall back to another engine. Codex sign-in and model choices are preserved. - 修复微软在线朗读连接失败，保留原有语音设置。更新保留书库、模型、书签和阅读记录。 Fixed Microsoft online speech connection failures while preserving voice settings. Updates retain books, models, bookmarks and reading history. - 本地小模型的专业译名和复杂内容仍需核对；PaddleOCR不支持所有语言和任意复杂版面。 Specialist names and complex local-model output still need review. PaddleOCR does not cover every language or document layout.
Wonder Reader 0.1.8 (66) - 修复章首图片和章节拼接额外添加空行。 Fixed extra blank lines before opening images and between document sections. - 改善EPUB、HTML和Word导入：保留显式诗歌换行、空段和预格式缩进，段落间不再强加空行。 Improved EPUB, HTML and Word imports to retain explicit poetry line breaks, empty paragraphs and preformatted indentation without adding blank lines between paragraphs. - 保留已有书籍、书签和处理结果。新导入规则需重新导入书籍才能应用；不自动改写旧书。 Existing books, bookmarks and results are preserved. Reimport a book to apply the new import rules; saved books are not rewritten automatically.
Wonder Reader 0.1.8 (65) - 提高微软在线朗读源音频码率至96kbps，新旧音质缓存分离。 Improved Microsoft online speech to 96 kbps, with separate caching for the improved audio. - 改善本地自动声音选择：优先高音质自然声音，保留手动选择；开始朗读时刷新已安装声音。 Improved automatic local voice selection, prioritizing high-quality natural voices while preserving manual choices and refreshing installed voices before playback. - 恢复设置中的支持作者页面；网站版仅提醒一次，阅读功能保持免费。 Restored Support the Developer in Settings. The website edition reminds you only once; all reading features remain free. - 处理完成后正文控件按窗口生命周期恢复焦点，避免首次按处理快捷键无响应；后台窗口不抢焦点。 Restore requested reading focus when the result view joins its active window, without stealing focus from background windows. - 在线总结统一使用专业术语约束，明确防止把相邻作品或论点错误归给最近出现的人名。 Online summaries now share terminology guidance and explicitly preserve attribution of works and claims. - 修复普通 PDF 当前页翻译和总结误处理全文；支持完整单页 OCR 结果继续翻译。全文 OCR 结果可在内容与源页精确匹配时继续处理当前页。 Fixed current-page translation and summary scopes for PDFs and chaining from completed OCR results. - 修复等价年代、生卒年连接号和中文写出的页眉数字导致翻译误报数字丢失；真正的数字变化、漏页码和缺失日期继续拦截。保留原书和历史结果。 Fixed false numeric-validation failures for equivalent date notation and source-supported written Chinese integers while retaining checks for changed or missing values. - 任务语音提示可在通用设置中关闭，完成提示更简短。系统提示直接使用旁白；微软提示沿用在线阅读参数。Control停止提示，/仍可主动查询进度。 Task voice prompts can be disabled in General settings. Shorter notices use VoiceOver in system mode or the online reading voice and settings in Microsoft mode. Control stops prompts; / still reports progress. - 重构在线 AI 任务连接：无需先进入设置或 AI 面板刷新账号，正文快捷键直接验证账号与所选模型，修复翻译、总结和 OCR 被错误拦截。 Reworked online AI task sessions so reading shortcuts validate the signed-in account and selected model directly, without requiring Settings or the AI panel to load first. - 改善中文夹英文字母和缩写的语音选择，避免将A、B、DNA等误判成其他语言；PDF排版换行不再强行拆开完整英文句子。 Improved voice routing for English letters and abbreviations in Chinese text and sentence handling across PDF line wraps. - 减少语言切换时首尾静音叠加，保留短自然间隔；修复句末换行覆盖自定义句子停顿的问题。 Reduced stacked silence at language switches and fixed sentence-pause settings being overridden by visual line endings. - 改善歌剧与音乐术语识别、全文术语采样及跨行完整姓名匹配，保留原名供模型理解，避免预先替换姓氏造成混合姓名。已有书籍和结果保留。 Improved musical terminology, glossary coverage and full-name matching across wrapped lines without changing existing books or saved results.
Wonder Reader 0.1.8 (57) - 修复在线翻译把英文月份（例如Each August）译成数字月份（每年8月）时被错误拦截；错误提示只列真正未匹配的数字。 Fixed numeric validation rejecting equivalent month translations, such as Each August → 每年8月. Errors now identify the remaining mismatches instead of listing valid written-number conversions. - 在线翻译按原文块一一对应返回，单独保留页眉及页码，再组合为正常译文；缺块、空块或数字不一致会被拦截，并有限缩块重译。原书、模型和思考深度不变。 Online translation now requires a matching result for each source unit, including running headers and page numbers, before assembling readable text. Missing or empty units and numeric mismatches remain checked, with bounded recovery using smaller chunks. Original books, model selections and reasoning settings are unchanged.
Wonder Reader 0.1.8 (56) - 新增Codex在线助读：浏览器登录ChatGPT账号后，可在设置和AI助读中选择账号支持的模型与思考深度，进行翻译、OCR及总结。本地和在线选项按所选模式显示。所选内容发送OpenAI，使用账号额度。 Added Codex online assistance: sign in to ChatGPT in your browser, then choose an available model and reasoning level in Settings or AI Assistance for translation, OCR and summaries. Local and online controls follow the selected mode. Selected content is sent to OpenAI using your account allowance. - 新增“导出原文件”，按导入格式恢复书库保存的原件，保留原始字节；TXT和Word仍导出当前阅读内容。 Added Export original file to restore the original retained in the library without changing its bytes or format. TXT and Word continue to export current reading content. - 修复在线翻译将 nineteenth、thirty-seven 等文字数字译为19、37时被错误拦截；保留漏数、错号和重复数字检查。已使用真实Codex连接验证短文翻译、总结及表格图片OCR。 Fixed numeric validation rejecting equivalent written-out numbers in translations. Missing literals, signs and unsupported repeated numbers remain checked. Short translation, summary and table-image OCR verified through the real Codex connection. - 设置窗口中Command-W只关闭设置，保留当前书籍和任务；主窗口中仍关闭书籍并保留窗口。 Command-W in Settings closes Settings only, keeping the book and tasks. In the main window it closes the book and keeps the window. - 通用设置新增默认开启的音效总开关；不影响朗读或旁白。启动时不再播报模型已就绪，真实模型错误显示提示窗口。 General settings now include a sound-effects switch, enabled by default. Narration and VoiceOver are unaffected. Startup model-ready announcements are removed; actual model errors show a dialog. - 微软在线语音新增默认折叠的停顿详细设置，可分别设置标点、句尾、换行和空行。默认原音，可选10–1000毫秒；在预缓存中保守调整可检测的末尾静音，实际间隔仍受音频和网络影响。 Online Microsoft speech adds collapsed pause settings for punctuation, sentence ends, line breaks and blank lines. Original audio remains default; 10–1000 ms choices conservatively adjust detectable trailing silence during prebuffering. Actual gaps also depend on audio and network timing. - 精简在线翻译请求，保留模型和思考深度选择；短文实测未确认速度提升，不宣称固定提速。 Online translation requests are shorter without changing model or reasoning choices. Short-text timings do not establish a speed improvement.
